_comment: THREE channels, each with one job.
cam-01  ANPR    reads number plates from Indian traffic footage
cam-02  THREAT  watches people and the objects near their hands
live    ALL     the operator's own camera, started from /live —
face + plate + threat on the same frames
A channel does one job because the two fixed modes need different
class sets, different framing and different evidence rules. The live
channel runs all three precisely because it is pointed by a human
who knows what they are pointing it at.
Sized to what this machine runs well: 7 cameras @0.70 CPU budget
pinned this laptop at 100%. The threat channel is cheaper than an
ANPR one - it never runs OCR, which is the expensive part.
